For the Petitioner : Mr. Sanjay Kr. Pandey, Advocate For the State : Mr. Rakesh Ranjan, A.P.P.

03/12.12.2024

2. The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Silli P.S. Case No. 20/2023, for the offences registered under Sections 406, 409 & 420 of the I.P.C., pending in the Court of Smt.
ManyaTandan, learned J.M.- XVIII, Ranchi.
3.
The petitioner happens to be Ex-Mukhiya of Nagedih Panchayat.

It is alleged that the petitioner alongwith Jal Sahiyas had embezzled Rs. 6,72,000/- (rupees six lakh seventy two thousand only)
allotted for construction of toilets (Sauchalaya).
4.
It was submitted that a joint bank account of the petitioner was opened with Jal Sahiyas namely Anita Devi and Sarita Devi.

It was further submitted that co-accused persons namely Sarita Devi and Anita Devi have been granted Anticipatory Bail by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court and the case Barun Manjhi @ Varun Kumar Manjhi vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...

sentences.text:

1 of the petitioner stands on similar footing.
5. Learned A.P.P has opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner and conceded the fact that the money was embezzled from the joint bank account of the petitioner and co-accused.
6. Considering the aforesaid facts, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of Smt.
Manya Tandan, learned J.M.- XVIII, Ranchi or her successor in connection with Silli P.S. Case No.
20/2023.

(Ambuj Nath, J.) Rahul/-
